name: Napoleon
hook: Waterloo, Elba, Josephine: the handful of facts behind a thousand Napoleonic clues.

facts.label: Corsica
facts.statement: Napoleon Bonaparte was born in 1769 on Corsica, which Genoa had ceded to France the year before — making him French.

facts.label: Emperor of the French
facts.statement: By the early 1800s his empire included the duchy of Warsaw, the kingdom of Naples and Spain.

facts.label: Waterloo
facts.statement: He was finally defeated at Waterloo in 1815 by the Duke of Wellington and Blücher's Prussian troops.

facts.label: Elba
facts.statement: His first exile was to Elba, the island off the Italian coast; he escaped and returned for the Hundred Days.

facts.label: St. Helena
facts.statement: He died in exile on St. Helena in the South Atlantic, where Longwood House is now a Napoleon museum.

facts.label: Josephine
facts.statement: Josephine, his first empress, spent her first 15 years on Martinique and narrowly escaped the guillotine.

facts.label: "The word is not French"
facts.statement: In an 1813 letter he wrote, "You write to me that it's impossible; the word is not French."
